name: Maestra's Post
summary: Along the road through western Ashenvale, Maestra's Post watches the way between Astranaar and the Ruins of Ordil'Aran. Night elven Sentinels guard the settlement, where a few humans serve the Alliance.

sections.title: A Forward Watch
sections.body: Maestra's Post keeps watch beneath the trees of western Ashenvale. A slender night elven tower and an open lodge mark the settlement along the road between the coast of Darkshore and Astranaar. Sentinels scan the surrounding wilds as corrupted furbolg stir nearby. Horde movements also threaten Alliance supply lines.

sections.title: An Alliance Gathering
sections.body: Maestra's Post brings a handful of human allies to live among the night elven Sentinels. Feero Ironhand and Delgren the Purifier lend their martial strength and devotion to the holy Light in service of the Alliance. This remote campsite is an early meeting place between the eastern kingdoms and Kalimdor's ancient defenders.

faq.answer: Maestra's Post lies in western Ashenvale, along the road northwest of Astranaar and south of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran.
No record at the post names Maestra. The outpost bears her name, but she is not among the Sentinels stationed there.

faq.q: Why are there humans at an elven outpost?
faq.answer: After the third war, the night elves joined the Alliance. Human travelers and warriors such as Feero Ironhand and Delgren the Purifier came to Kalimdor to offer aid and strengthen ties with their night elf allies.
Corrupted furbolg clans lurk in the surrounding woodland, while Horde scouting parties and incursions press into Ashenvale.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers leaving Darkshore, Maestra's Post offers a friendly welcome and a fortified refuge in Ashenvale's contested forests.
As a night elf, you see the new Alliance taking shape here: Sentinels share hearth and watch duty with the younger races of the Eastern Kingdoms.
